[General] This test asserts `getBatchSize()` returns `0` for an empty batch, but `DbExecution` (unchanged in this PR) computes `this.batchSize = queryInfoBatchSize > 1 ? (long) queryInfoBatchSize : null;` — so when `batchSize` is `0`, `getBatchSize()` returns `null`, not `0`. The assertion will fail at runtime.

Since the PR description states the core behavior change is deferred to #19036, this assertion should match the current production behavior (i.e., `null`).

replies.body: No code change needed. The `batchSize(0)` / `getBatchSize().isEqualTo(0)` assertion is no longer present on the PR head; the current nearby test asserts `null`, matching the existing `DbExecution` behavior for non-reportable batch sizes.
